newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mun Loong seeks share suspension on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Mun Loong seeks share suspension on Monday.

text.p: Malaysia's diversified Mun Loong Bhd has asked the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) to suspend trading in its shares on Monday for an announcement.
It said in a statement to the KLSE that it wanted trading to be suspended for one day.
In a separate statement, the company said it would announce the projects, including in the construction business, it plans to undertake next year.
The company has called for a news conference to make the announcement at 0200 GMT on Monday.
